eval.description: METR metric for how long a task humans take that an AI agent completes with 50% success. Agents run on software and research tasks with human time baselines; a logistic fit of success versus log human duration yields the 50% (and often 80%) time horizon. Many tasks stay private; public analysis code and some run data are released.
eval.summary: Measures the length of human task time that AI agents can finish with 50% success.

scores.description: 1 if the agent successfully completes that task attempt under the run’s scoring rules.

metrics.description: Human-expert task duration at which the fitted success curve crosses 50%. Cards report this as METR 50% time horizon.
Human-expert task duration at which the fitted success curve crosses 80%.
